$Classic Controller
*By quatric
*Metroid Prime 3: Corruption (USA) (RM3E01)
*Play with a Classic Controller plugged into the Wii Remote: left stick moves, right stick aims the pointer.
*A/R shoot, B jump, Y missile, X morph ball, ZL lock-on, L visor change, ZR beam change, + pause, - map.
* KPAD sampling callback: Classic Controller sample -> Wii Remote + Nunchuk sample

$GameCube controller
*By quatric
*Metroid Prime 3: Corruption (USA) (RM3E01)
*Play with a GameCube controller in port 1 (no Wii Remote needed):
*control stick moves, C-stick aims pointer, A/R shoot, B jump, Y missile, X morph ball, L lock-on, Z visor, Start pause.
* KPAD sampling callback: GameCube pad -> Wii Remote + Nunchuk sample
